items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: And I know there was Leonard Jean

ctx.x: And I know there was Leonard Jean, and I went and Jane and Eve and I went someplace, and I don't know the whole atmosphere of the thing was changed. So I said, to Eve, I'm going out to California. I'm -- we'll see. So I went out, and I stayed with a friend of mine out there, and I said, "Yeah, I like it here," so I -- came back and got Eve, we went out there. Now I didn't have nothing, and we lived in Santa Monica where I lived -- and I still live there. And, now when I was living there in this first period, that…
